content.prompt:
The chart below shows the percentage of adults in three age groups in one country who took part in five types of physical activity at least once a month in 2023.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
content.figure_title: Adults taking part in physical activities at least once a month, by age group, 2023
key_features: Overview: walking was the most popular activity in every age group and was the only one whose participation increased with age; all the other activities became less popular in older groups.
Walking rose from 58% of 18–34-year-olds to 66% of 35–59-year-olds and 72% of those aged 60 and over.
Gym and fitness classes showed the widest gap: 46% of the youngest group (their second most popular activity) compared with only 14% of the oldest.
Team sports were the least popular activity overall, falling from 27% to 12% and then to just 3% among the over-60s; cycling also dropped sharply after 59 (28% to 11%).
Swimming had the most even participation across the age groups, declining only gradually from 24% to 17%.
